title: Improving Neutral Point-of-View Generation with Data- and Parameter-Efficient RL
benchmark_measurement: Ability to generate Neutral Point of View (NPOV) responses on controversial topics, including several with religious themes (e.g., the role of churches in taxation, religious food in schools, and construction of mosques).
models_tested: Generic LLM (~60B parameters, used for autorating)
findings: The paper does not provide findings specific to religious topics. The general findings are that parameter-efficient reinforcement learning (PE-RL) is highly effective for improving the generation of neutral, informative, and multi-perspective answers on all controversial topics tested, which include topics related to religion.
